Tidy a VAR fit

Source: R/tidiers.R
tidy.varm.Rd

Coefficient table of a varm() fit in the broom convention, a one-row model summary, and the data augmented with fitted values and residuals.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'varm'
tidy(x, conf.int = FALSE, conf.level = 0.95, ...)

# S3 method for class 'varm'
glance(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'varm'
augment(x, data = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

a varm fit.

conf.int

include conf.low / conf.high (t-based).

conf.level

confidence level for conf.int.

...

unused.

data

data to augment; defaults to the data used for the fit.

Value

tidy(): a tibble with response, term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value (and conf.low, conf.high). glance(): one row with K, p, nobs, logLik, AIC, BIC, HQ, max_root. augment(): the data plus .fitted_<var> and .resid_<var> columns (NA for the first p rows).

See also

Other tidiers: tidy.varm_forecast(), tidy.varm_hd(), tidy.varm_irf()

Examples

fit <- varm(yraw, p = 2)
tidy(fit)
#> # A tibble: 21 × 6
#>    response term     estimate std.error statistic  p.value
#>    <chr>    <chr>       <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>
#>  1 infl     infl.l1   1.54       0.0596    25.8   2.13e-66
#>  2 infl     unemp.l1 -0.281      0.0622    -4.52  1.05e- 5
#>  3 infl     rate.l1  -0.0571     0.0295    -1.93  5.45e- 2
#>  4 infl     infl.l2  -0.542      0.0613    -8.84  4.41e-16
#>  5 infl     unemp.l2  0.234      0.0592     3.95  1.09e- 4

#> 10 unemp    rate.l1  -0.0210     0.0318    -0.660 5.10e- 1
